confirmed_basis: Public products demonstrate joint activity and referrals; the internal source-to-clearance workflow has not been reviewed.
proposed_additional_control: Use an existing record system only where a particular factual-support control is missing.
unresolved_question: Would the proposed record replace or improve a named step, or simply duplicate a control already operating?

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing substantive/reporting owners on both sides of each case.
closure_rule: Document equivalent functionality and close the added proposal, or identify a specific missing step and its consequences; silence is not consent.
consequence_while_open: Do not claim incremental value or proceed to live shadow without a case-specific gap finding.

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: UNOWAS and UNOCA factual/reporting custodians, to be nominated by their owners.
closure_rule: Close the proposal if equivalent controls exist; otherwise define the missing qualification rule. Do not choose a start date by majority vote.
consequence_while_open: Keep disputed dates qualified; no eliminated travel or verified operational defect claim.

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing workshop/reporting focal points and the publication custodian.
closure_rule: Identify a control gap or retain the current method; do not equate publication with a second workshop or adoption with implementation.
consequence_while_open: No duplicate workshop, instructor cost, attendance total or productivity claim.

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing substantive owners and locally approved factual/review custodians.

consequence_while_open: No combined 205-item measure, Secretariat endorsement of party text, or substitution for operational activity.

confirmed_basis: V10 approval fields remain incomplete; selecting the research reference did not grant institutional authority.

confirmed_basis: Public research storage is not approved storage for internal drafts, live staff logs or incident narratives.

topic: Prospective scope and comparable quality review
confirmed_basis: The 61 historical obligations are fixed research items; future live claims and product windows are not yet enrolled.
proposed_additional_control: Predeclare eligible families, matched input waves, language/tasks, exposure and reviewer rubric under V10.
unresolved_question: Can each method receive comparable inputs and be judged on the same factual-support duties without carryover or hidden dependence?

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Both product owners and a locally nominated reviewer/measurement custodian.

consequence_while_open: No full-report versus short-fact-sheet comparison; no independent-review or causal-effect claim.

topic: Effort limits, capture and added burden
confirmed_basis: No live time or update latency has been measured; V10 sets accounting rules but leaves numerical ceilings and buffers unset.
proposed_additional_control: Use existing empty instruments to distinguish normal, shadow, common, setup and evaluation effort; retain all shifted and failed work.
unresolved_question: What additional burden is permissible, and can comparable task time be captured without estimates or missing work?
minimum_evidence: Owner-set person-minute ceiling and deadline buffer, expected-task roster, capture procedure and escalation/stop route before any live measurement.
evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Both workflow owners and local workload custodian.
closure_rule: Set limits prospectively. Missing or estimated time makes complete-process contrasts ineligible; material quality failures preclude advancement despite speed.
consequence_while_open: No live collection without limits; any later shadow contrast remains descriptive, not labor saved.

confirmed_basis: Retrospective source reuse and a future parallel shadow do not establish that an existing work step disappears.
proposed_additional_control: Only later, test replacement of one named step under separately authorized conditions.
unresolved_question: Can the step be removed without reducing output quality or transferring concealed work to another team?
minimum_evidence: Separate approved substitution design, accountable step owner, comparable quality results and observed replacement/shifted effort; not a hypothetical percentage.
evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Existing workflow owners and independent/declaration-qualified evaluator as locally approved.
closure_rule: Demonstrate actual displacement and full added burden or do not claim capacity gain. Preserve dissent and failed replacement.
consequence_while_open: Not an entry requirement for discussing the proposal; blocks any avoided-labor claim.

evidence_holder_role_not_assignment: Relevant authorized finance/budget owners, only for a later approved assessment.
closure_rule: Substantiate cash release net of added costs or retain not estimated. Count shared C02/C05/C09 enabling work only once.
consequence_while_open: No dollar/percentage savings target, post reduction, budget cut or ranking change supported by this package.
